svg.title: Arrakis orbit — Eclipse
svg.metadata:
CHOAM background texture credits
Planet maps by Solar System Scope / INOVE, based on NASA elevation and imagery. Source collection: https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/ Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0): https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
File: arrakis.jpg Source: https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/download/8k_mars.jpg Adapted: resized from 8192 x 4096 to 4096 x 2048; desaturated and recolored to sand and ochre for a fictional desert planet; JPEG recompressed.
File: caladan-clouds.jpg Source: https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/download/8k_earth_clouds.jpg Adapted: grayscale, resized from 8192 x 4096 to 2048 x 1024; JPEG recompressed. Rendered over a fictional ocean with separate cloud movement and shadows.
File: moon.jpg Source: https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/download/2k_moon.jpg Adapted: grayscale, resized from 2048 x 1024 to 1024 x 512; JPEG recompressed.
These are artistic interpretations, not astronomical or canonical Dune maps. No endorsement by the texture authors or NASA is implied.
Generated from the local texture artwork. Sphere lighting is baked; CSS animates drift and starlight.
